description: Use this when the linked LeakData user asks whether their own email was in a data breach ("Has my email been leaked?", "Am I in the Canva breach?", "Am I affected by any recent leaks?"). For a current check, call this tool and report only its returned results; never present earlier results as a new check, and if the call fails say the check could not be completed. For their own email, set type to email and omit query: the server uses the verified primary email of the linked account. If the user typed an address of their own, put it in query; only the verified primary email is checked, and for another address they own the result explains how to add it in LeakData. Never call this for someone else's address or to look up passwords, and never guess an address. No results means no LeakData record matched: never say the email is safe or was never leaked; a breach whose records LeakData does not hold cannot show up. Results for the user's other monitored addresses come from leakdata.protection_summary; company domains use leakdata.company_monitoring.

query.description: Omit to check the linked account's verified primary email. If the user typed an address of their own, pass it here; only the verified primary email is checked.

name: leakdata.search
title: Check your email
